headline: Nvidia Unveils Open Models for Enterprise and On-Device AI Agents
summary: Nvidia has launched new open-source AI models to enable enterprises to run their own AI agents in-house and on personal computers, challenging proprietary platforms and accelerating local AI deployment.
whyItMatters: This shift broadens access to advanced AI capabilities and reduces reliance on closed APIs, fostering innovation and competition in the AI industry.
